commit_scope: Add a bounded unlisted-public Form-grounded dialogue CPU lane with persistent receipts, crash recovery, source disclosure gates, MCP access, expiry, and removal.

local_validation.details: Form source preflight returned zero errors, warnings, and unresolved calls; Go/Rust/TypeScript returned 63; direct fkwu returned 63; 71 focused Docker/config/dialogue/MCP/federation tests and 51 shared grounding/MCP-substrate regression tests passed with Python warnings promoted to errors. The full local PR guard passed 403 selected API tests, the production web build, and the live worktree runtime check; the exact CI-equivalent full API suite passed all 2102 tests after the application-recipe ownership set, nested kernel-core source reader, and final review repairs were healed. Strict spec, evidence, index, maintainability, and git diff gates passed. The kernel submodule's healed form-cli boundary was regenerated into source-bound bootstrap and Darwin carriers; a cache-empty standard lane copied the committed binary without clang, answered the new carrier identity and pong, the form-cli band returned 524287 on all four arms, and the FNRI source, native dispatch, and standalone witnesses passed. The Windows full-model composition receipt now resolves the nested source checkout and flat image layout through one runtime directory; all six previously misrouted four-way gates passed locally at 255, 1023, 31, 255, 255, and 2097151, with a contract test guarding every executable validate path. The regeneration recipe now reuses the canonical witnessed stamp instead of a drift-prone duplicate source list. Two independent AI review rounds were run after local proof; the second round's one launch blocker and four hardening signals were embodied and re-witnessed. Sixteen GitHub AI-review threads were also embodied: accepted dialogue requests execute their real six-field envelope in Form before persistence, federation offers/reads receive operation-specific encoded shapes in Form, idempotent retry repairs atomically published message indexes, potentially blocking HTTP/MCP Form admission runs in worker threads after known capacity and pacing refusals are screened, federation index read-modify-replace operations are serialized across API processes, running-dialogue release/reaping executes outside both async request loops, the federation recipe resolves from the application package in both source and deployed image layouts, the capacity/rate gate remains atomically held through Form admission and row persistence, and Uvicorn trusts forwarded caller identity only from the observed internal Docker proxy range. Later review rounds moved same-process admission into a nonblocking pre-session slot and PostgreSQL admission onto pg_try_advisory_xact_lock, moved both HTTP and MCP polling into worker threads, installed the Linux process inspector used by ownership-safe reaping, added ownership-safe Windows task-tree termination, moved proxy and federation-store settings onto the shared file-backed configuration precedence, kept the container listener aligned with its fixed expose, healthcheck, and proxy port at 8000, and retained the non-public removal-capability hash so identical retries succeed while different capabilities remain rejected. The proxy witnesses preserve two public peers through one Traefik/kernel-router carrier while refusing a forged forwarded identity from an untrusted peer. The concurrency witnesses held dialogue admission, polling, and release open while both public information surfaces remained responsive, refused a second admission before another session or Form process opened, and preserved both IDs in a deliberately widened two-process federation race on five consecutive runs. The broad re-witness also exposed and healed a pre-existing import-order seam by registering verification hash-chain models before unified schema creation; its formerly failing fresh-database request passed alone and within the 2102-test body. Direct native acceptance/refusal calls and the focused warning-strict suites passed afterward.
